evidence: Parent criterion 6: 'After each story make verify failed only on the 17 known arm64-host pandoc tests under tests/unit/reconciler (it cannot exit 0 on this host) and the story's Gerrit change reached Verified +1.'
3f35 final AC: 'make verify exits 0 apart from the 17 arm64-host pandoc failures tracked in frenzied-snively-llama.' — no Gerrit Verified +1 clause.
7300 final AC: 'make verify green apart from the 17 arm64-host pandoc failures ...' — no Gerrit Verified +1 clause.
a757 final AC: 'make verify passes apart from the 17 arm64-host pandoc failures ...' — no Gerrit Verified +1 clause.
Contrast: e873 final AC: 'make verify shows no failure outside the known pandoc set, and the Gerrit change is Verified +1'; bbce landing note records 'Verified +1'.
container pairing: parent + 3f35-f1af-7a0f-4376/7300-7fab-807c-4ea0/a757-f58a-34cc-4ad1/bbce-1846-1dd1-49ca/e873-b770-693c-4ff5
findings.finding: Parent acceptance criterion 6 is a conjunction applied per story ('After each story make verify failed only on the 17 known pandoc tests ... AND the story's Gerrit change reached Verified +1'), but three children's roster acceptance criteria assert only the make-verify half and omit the 'Gerrit change reached Verified +1' half: 3f35, 7300, and a757. Only bbce and e873 include the Gerrit-Verified-+1 clause in their ACs.
scenarios: A completion verifier checking parent criterion 6 against each child's ACs finds the Gerrit-Verified-+1 observable outcome is not an acceptance check in 3f35/7300/a757, so the per-story Gerrit-gate half of the parent criterion is not provably enforced by those children's ACs.
findings.suggested_fix: Append ' and the Gerrit change reached Verified +1' to the make-verify acceptance criterion of 3f35, 7300, and a757 so each story's ACs mirror the parent criterion 6 conjunction (as bbce and e873 already do).

findings.finding: Children bbce (S2) and a757 (S4) hold contradictory assumptions about _OPTIONALITY_SUITE_ITEM_COUNT in tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py: bbce plans for S4 to flip the constant from 10 to 9 ('_OPTIONALITY_SUITE_ITEM_COUNT stays at 10 in this story; S4 sets it to 9 when it deletes one test_core_optionality.py test'), but a757 keeps it at 10, asserting 'test_core_optionality.py still collects 3 tests, so _OPTIONALITY_SUITE_ITEM_COUNT stays 10' and makes 'test_ci_workflow_parity.py passes with _OPTIONALITY_SUITE_ITEM_COUNT == 10' an acceptance criterion.
